history.name: An edition that hasn't been presented says so
history.description: Printing the release still in progress produces a document marked as a draft not yet presented, in a neutral colour rather than one of the two that carry meaning. A work-in-progress copy can be circulated internally without any chance of it being mistaken for the client's edition.
history.dev_notes: The .edition.is-draft / .is-final states on the cover, keyed off the release's status.
